name: Induced Refusal (Context Bomb)
description: Text planted in content an AI system will read — a request for prohibited material, or a string written to look like one — so that the model's own safety guardrails make it refuse or stop, denying the AI function to whoever depends on it. Reported as "context bombs" and "reverse jailbreaks".
differs: The inverse of Jailbreak & Safety Bypass (T1.004): the aim is to cause a refusal, not to avoid one. When the system being stopped is a security analyser the outcome is AI Analysis Evasion (T9.004). Defenders use the same mechanism in decoys to halt attacking agents.
